question: Where is the nearest restaurant encountered en route to Fred Crabtree Park, Herndon, VA from Rock of the Marne, VA?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state, p.amenity, p.cuisine FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects( p.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Rock of the Marne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%VA%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT pa.geometry FROM parks AS pa WHERE pa.park_name ILIKE '%Fred Crabtree Park%' AND ST_Intersects( pa.geometry::geography, ( SELECT r.geometry::geography FROM regions AS r WHERE r.region_name ILIKE '%Herndon%' AND r.border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1 ) ) LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 500 )::geography ) ORDER BY ST_Distance( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Rock of the Marne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%VA%' LIMIT 1 )::geography ) LIMIT 1;
